source: Synthetic data written for this project
notes: details.new.json has a value for every mapped legacy field; the legacy half is derived with toLegacyPrediction and toLegacyPlaceResult. JSON cannot hold functions, so details.legacy.json omits opening_hours.isOpen and photos[].getUrl. The prediction carries distanceMeters to cover distance_meters. Addresses, phone numbers and URLs are placeholders.
